name: Quiet Luxury
tagline: Understated elegance in cashmere, linen and calm, minimal spaces.
description: Stealth-wealth style without a single logo: tonal cashmere, fine linen and long wool coats in galleries, limestone apartments, boutique hotels and quiet seaside terraces. Muted palettes, soft daylight and calm confidence, a modern counterpart to Old Money.
